quiz.explain: A review is a short note from a happy client saying you did good work.
options: A short note from a happy client
quiz.q: What is a review?

quiz.explain: Reviews build trust, so new clients are more likely to hire you.
options: Reviews build trust for new clients
Reviews are only for big VAs
quiz.q: Why do reviews matter?

quiz.explain: Ask happily right after good work, when the client is most pleased.
options: Ask happily right after good work
quiz.q: When should you ask for a review?

steps: List your happy practice clients.
Message one of them: thank them and ask for a short review.
Make it easy: ask for two or three sentences.
Thank them when they send it.
Add the review to your profile.
Ask happy clients if they know someone who needs a VA.
days.task: Ask one happy client for a review and a referral.
days.title: Get Reviews and Referrals

days.challenge: Write down what your VA business will look like in one year.
days.goal: Grow from VA to agency.

quiz.explain: Growing means raising prices, finding better clients, and maybe hiring other VAs.
options: Raising prices, better clients, maybe hiring help
quiz.q: What does growing as a VA mean?

quiz.explain: Better clients pay more, respect your time, and bring repeat work.
options: Better clients pay more and bring repeat work
quiz.q: Why find better clients as you grow?

quiz.explain: Hiring help lets you take bigger jobs, but only when you earn enough to pay for it.
options: Hiring help lets you take bigger jobs, when you earn enough
Hiring help is only for agencies
quiz.q: When should you hire help?

steps: Write down where you want to be in one year.
List three steps to get there: better clients, higher prices, new skills.
Pick one new skill to learn next.
Write down when you will raise your prices again.
Think about what help you might need one day.
Write your one-year goal on one page.
days.task: Write a one-year growth plan for your VA business.
days.title: Grow From VA to Agency

days.challenge: Work one hour less today and rest properly.
days.goal: Avoid burnout: rest, limits and balance.

quiz.explain: Burnout means feeling exhausted from working too much without rest.
options: Feeling exhausted from working too much without rest
quiz.q: What is burnout?

quiz.explain: Setting work hours and taking breaks protects your energy and your quality.
options: Setting hours and taking breaks protects energy and quality
quiz.q: How do you avoid burnout?

quiz.explain: Saying no to too much work protects your health and your clients.
options: Saying no protects your health and clients
quiz.q: Why say no to too much work?

steps: Write down your work hours and your rest hours.
Take a 10-minute break every hour.
Stop work at your set time today.
Do one thing you enjoy that is not work.
Write down three signs you are tired and need rest.
Set one rule: no work messages after your work hours.
days.task: Set your work hours and rest rule, and stop work on time today.
days.title: Avoid Burnout

days.challenge: Score your VA work from 1 to 10 on clients, delivery, money and growth.
days.goal: Audit your VA work.

quiz.explain: A VA audit checks your clients, delivery, money, and growth to find strengths and gaps.
options: Asking a friend to judge you
quiz.q: What is a VA audit?

quiz.explain: Fix the weakest part first, because it holds your whole VA work back.
quiz.q: What should you fix first after an audit?

quiz.explain: Honest audits show real progress and real gaps.
options: Honest audits show real progress and gaps
quiz.q: Why audit your VA work honestly?

steps: Score yourself from 1 to 10 on clients, delivery, money and growth.
Write down your best task and your worst task this month.
Look at your numbers: clients, hours, earnings.
Write down three strengths and three gaps.
Fix the biggest gap with one action today.
Write one sentence about what you learned this month.
days.task: Write a full VA audit with scores, strengths, gaps and one fix done today.
days.title: Audit Your VA Work

days.challenge: Share your 90-day plan with a friend and ask them to check on you monthly.
days.goal: Write a 90-day VA plan that keeps you winning clients.

quiz.explain: A 90-day plan sets monthly goals and weekly actions for the next three months.
options: Monthly goals and weekly actions for three months
A copy of your first plan
quiz.q: What is a 90-day VA plan?

quiz.explain: The next 90 days should win more clients, lift your prices, and grow your reviews.
options: Do the same as the first 30 days
Win more clients, lift prices, grow reviews
quiz.q: How should you plan the next 90 days?

quiz.explain: A weekly review keeps the plan honest and lets you adjust fast.
options: A weekly review lets you adjust based on real numbers
quiz.q: Why review your plan every week?

steps: Look at your audit from day 29.
Set one VA goal for each of the next three months.
Break each goal into four weekly actions.
Pick one skill to improve each month.
Add a 30-minute weekly review to your calendar.
Write the plan on one page and pin it where you will see it.
days.task: Write a one-page 90-day VA plan with monthly goals, weekly actions and a review time.
days.title: Your 90-Day VA Plan
